requirement.description: The receive_messages method in SubprocessCLITransport is returning a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be used directly in an async for loop. The method should properly yield parsed JSON messages from the CLI output stream.

requirement.description: The query method in ClaudeSDKClient is incorrectly handling AsyncIterable prompts by creating a new transport instead of properly reusing or managing the existing transport, which breaks the streaming behavior.
requirement.contract: The query method should properly handle AsyncIterable prompts by either reusing the existing transport or ensuring proper connection management without breaking the streaming flow.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method is not properly handling the case when it receives an AsyncIterable prompt, and doesn't properly manage stdin closing behavior which affects concurrent operations.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method should correctly handle AsyncIterable prompts and properly manage stdin lifecycle for both streaming and one-shot modes.

requirement.description: The session_id handling in the query method is not consistent with what the tests expect, particularly in test_send_message_with_session_id.
requirement.contract: The query method should properly pass session_id to the transport's send_request method and ensure session IDs are preserved in messages.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method is not correctly handling AsyncIterable prompts in one-shot query mode, causing issues with the transport initialization.
requirement.contract: The process_query method should correctly initialize transport with AsyncIterable prompts and properly manage the connection lifecycle.
